The bullet attributes the ChiefChilly/Player staleness to main's 9b8cb8add editing include/ChiefChilly.h and include/Player.h. That is the wrong half of the commit: queue_audit derives total_lines by summing lines over the delinks-resolved source paths of the row's range, which are src/ paths only, and no include/ path appears in config/arm9/delinks.txt, so a header edit cannot move the cell. The commit attribution and the direction of responsibility are therefore both correct and independently verified; 9b8cb8add is an ancestor of both bdcb1df7d and the branch's merge-base c52f63ca5, so it is genuinely main's. Only the named mechanism is wrong. It moves no number, changes no gate verdict and does not affect this branch's attribution, and under source_review a provenance finding may not be deferred, so raising it would require a corrective commit that mode verify forbids -- converting a wrong noun into a hard publish refusal. It clears as-is and is recorded here so the next writer touching this bullet fixes the sentence. Disposition unchanged: fixed.
